mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Where the effect applies. Always `all` for now.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: String ID of the user who owns the task.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: String ID of the project that contains the task.

section_id.title: Section Id
section_id.description: String ID of the section that contains the task, or `null` if the task is not in a section.

parent_id.title: Parent Id
parent_id.description: String ID of the parent task, or `null` if this is a top-level task.

added_by_uid.title: Added By Uid
added_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who created the task, or `null` if unknown.

assigned_by_uid.title: Assigned By Uid
assigned_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who assigned the task, or `null` if unassigned.

responsible_uid.title: Responsible Uid
responsible_uid.description: String ID of the user responsible for the task, or `null` if unassigned.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Names of labels attached to the task.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Deadline details for the task, or `null` when the task has no deadline.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Task duration details, or `null` when the task has no duration.

is_collapsed.title: Is Collapsed
is_collapsed.description: Whether the task is collapsed in the user's view.

added_at.title: Added At
added_at.description: Date and time when the task was created, or `null` if unknown.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: Date and time when the task was completed, or `null` if active.

completed_by_uid.title: Completed By Uid
completed_by_uid.description: String ID of the user who completed the task, or `null` if active.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Date and time when the task was last updated, or `null` if unknown.

due.title: Due
due.description: Due date details for the task, or `null` when the task has no due date.

child_order.title: Child Order
child_order.description: Position of the task among sibling tasks.

order_key.title: Order Key
order_key.description: Fractional-indexing order key: tasks sort by comparing keys lexicographically among siblings sharing the same project, section and parent task. May be `null` for tasks not yet migrated.

note_count.title: Note Count
note_count.description: **Deprecated**: only returns 0 and is marked for removal.

completed_count.title: Completed Count
completed_count.description: Number of times the task has been marked as completed. Increments on every completion, including recurring occurrences and re-completions of a previously reopened task. Decremented when a recurring completion is undone.

postponed_count.title: Postponed Count
postponed_count.description: Number of times the task's due date has been rescheduled by the user. Increments on any due-date change between two set dates (forward or backward); recurring completions and undos are not counted.

SectionSyncView.title: SectionSyncView
SectionSyncView.description:
A class with fields representing a SectionView which will be returned
to clients in a sync (or sync-like) response.

items.title: Items
items.description: Completed tasks in the current page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of completed tasks, when more results are available. Omitted when there is no next page.

full_name.title: Full Name
full_name.description: The user's real name formatted as Firstname Lastname

has_password.title: Has Password
has_password.description: Whether the user has a password set on the account. It will be false if they have only authenticated without a password (e.g. using Google, Facebook, etc.)

verification_status.title: Verification Status
verification_status.description: User's email verification status. unverified (just signed up), verified (verified email or social login), blocked (failed to verify in 7 days), legacy (signed up before August 2022)

token.title: Token
token.description: The user's token that should be used to call the other API methods

is_premium.title: Is Premium
is_premium.description: Whether the user has a Todoist Pro subscription (a true or false value)

premium_status.title: Premium Status
premium_status.description: Outlines why a user is premium, possible values are: not_premium, current_personal_plan, legacy_personal_plan or teams_business_member

premium_until.title: Premium Until
premium_until.description: The date when the user's Todoist Pro subscription ends (null if not a Todoist Pro user). This should be used for informational purposes only as this does not include the grace period upon expiration

free_trial_expires.title: Free Trial Expires
free_trial_expires.description: Date when free trial expires (ISO 8601 format)

has_started_a_trial.title: Has Started A Trial
has_started_a_trial.description: Whether the user has ever started a free trial

joined_at.title: Joined At
joined_at.description: Date when user joined Todoist (ISO 8601 format)

deleted_at.title: Deleted At
deleted_at.description: Date when user was deleted (ISO 8601 format)

business_account_id.title: Business Account Id
business_account_id.description: The ID of the user's business account

date_format.title: Date Format
date_format.description: Whether to use the DD-MM-YYYY date format (if set to 0), or the MM-DD-YYYY format (if set to 1)

time_format.title: Time Format
time_format.description: Whether to use a 24h format such as 13:00 (if set to 0) when displaying time, or a 12h format such as 1:00pm (if set to 1)

sort_order.title: Sort Order
sort_order.description: Whether to show projects in an oldest dates first order (if set to 0), or a oldest dates last order (if set to 1)

theme_id.title: Theme Id
theme_id.description: The currently selected Todoist theme (a number between 0 and 13)

theme_appearance.description: Whether Todoist uses a light theme, a dark theme, or follows the system appearance

start_day.title: Start Day
start_day.description: The first day of the week (between 1 and 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday)

weekend_start_day.title: Weekend Start Day
weekend_start_day.description: The day used when a user chooses to schedule a task for the 'Weekend' (between 1 and 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday)

next_week.title: Next Week
next_week.description: The day of the next week, that tasks will be postponed to (between 1 and 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday)

auto_reminder.title: Auto Reminder
auto_reminder.description: The default time in minutes for the automatic reminders set, whenever a due date has been specified for a task

urgent_reminder_device.description: The device that should ring urgent reminders. Contains device_id, device_token, device_platform (ios or android), and optionally device_name.

status.description: The user's status, shared across Todoist and Comms. `null` when the user has none or it has expired. Set or clear it with `user_update`.

start_page.title: Start Page
start_page.description: The user's default view on Todoist. The start page can be one of the following: inbox, teaminbox, today, next7days, upcoming, assigned_to_me, project?id=1234 to open a project, label?name=abc to open a label, filter?id=1234 to open a filter, or workspace_filter?id=1234 to open a workspace filter

inbox_project_id.title: Inbox Project Id
inbox_project_id.description: The ID of the user's Inbox project

tz_info.title: Tz Info
tz_info.description: The user's timezone (a dictionary structure), which includes the following elements: the timezone as a string value, the hours and minutes difference from GMT, whether daylight saving time applies denoted by is_dst, and a string value of the time difference from GMT that is gmt_string

karma_trend.title: Karma Trend
karma_trend.description: The user's karma trend. Can be 'up', 'down', or '-' (no change)

daily_goal.title: Daily Goal
daily_goal.description: The daily goal number of completed tasks for karma

weekly_goal.title: Weekly Goal
weekly_goal.description: The target number of tasks to complete per week

days_off.title: Days Off
days_off.description: Array of integers representing user's days off (between 1 and 7, where 1 is Monday and 7 is Sunday)

completed_count.title: Completed Count
completed_count.description: Total number of tasks completed by user

completed_today.title: Completed Today
completed_today.description: Number of tasks completed today by the user

share_limit.title: Share Limit
share_limit.description: Maximum number of collaborators allowed in shared projects

features.title: Features
features.description: Feature flags and settings for the user

feature_identifier.title: Feature Identifier
feature_identifier.description: Feature identifier for feature flag evaluations

joinable_workspace.title: Joinable Workspace
joinable_workspace.description: Information about workspaces the user can join

onboarding_completed.title: Onboarding Completed
onboarding_completed.description: Whether the user has completed onboarding

onboarding_initiated.title: Onboarding Initiated
onboarding_initiated.description: Whether the user has initiated onboarding

onboarding_started.title: Onboarding Started
onboarding_started.description: Whether the user has started onboarding

onboarding_level.title: Onboarding Level
onboarding_level.description: User's self-reported skill level during onboarding

onboarding_team_mode.title: Onboarding Team Mode
onboarding_team_mode.description: Whether user selected team mode during onboarding

onboarding_use_cases.title: Onboarding Use Cases
onboarding_use_cases.description: Use cases the user selected during onboarding

getting_started_guide_projects.title: Getting Started Guide Projects
getting_started_guide_projects.description: List of project IDs for getting started guide

onboarded_dated_tasks_created.title: Onboarded Dated Tasks Created
onboarded_dated_tasks_created.description: True once the user has created at least 1 task with a due date that includes a time component (excluding auto-seeded getting-started-guide tasks).

onboarded_tasks_completed.title: Onboarded Tasks Completed
onboarded_tasks_completed.description: True once the user has completed at least 3 tasks.

onboarded_mobile_accessed.title: Onboarded Mobile Accessed
onboarded_mobile_accessed.description: True once the user has synced from iOS or Android.

onboarded_desktop_accessed.title: Onboarded Desktop Accessed
onboarded_desktop_accessed.description: True once the user has synced from Web, macOS, or Windows.

is_onboarded.title: Is Onboarded
is_onboarded.description: Composite flag: true once all four onboarded_* criteria above are met.

activated_user.title: Activated User
activated_user.description: Whether the user is considered activated (completed key onboarding actions)

has_magic_number.title: Has Magic Number
has_magic_number.description: Whether the user has reached a magic number milestone

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: The ID of the user's avatar

avatar_big.title: Avatar Big
avatar_big.description: The link to a 195x195 pixels image of the user's avatar

avatar_medium.title: Avatar Medium
avatar_medium.description: The link to a 60x60 pixels image of the user's avatar

avatar_s640.title: Avatar S640
avatar_s640.description: The link to a 640x640 pixels image of the user's avatar

avatar_small.title: Avatar Small
avatar_small.description: The link to a 35x35 pixels image of the user's avatar

UserJSON.title: UserSyncView
UserJSON.description:
A model for the user objects returned by the sync/REST API.

This model is used purely for OpenAPI documentation generation and does not
handle actual serialization (which is handled by @todoist.models.json.user.generate).

message.title: Message
message.description: The status text. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

active_until.title: Active Until
active_until.description: When the status and its effects expire, in UTC. `null` or omitted means it stays until cleared.

UserStatus.title: UserStatus
UserStatus.description: A user's status, as sent by clients and stored in the `status` user property.

pause_notifications.description: Pauses the user's notifications, in products that support it, while the status is active.

pause_activity.description: Pauses the user's productivity metrics (Karma and streaks) in Todoist while the status is active, as Vacation Mode does.

UserStatusEffects.title: UserStatusEffects
UserStatusEffects.description:
The optional behaviors a status enables. Empty for an informational status.
Each effect is independent: a status may carry either, both, or neither.

can_assign_tasks.title: Can Assign Tasks
can_assign_tasks.description: Whether the current user can assign tasks in the project.

can_comment.title: Can Comment
can_comment.description: Whether the current user can comment in the project.

child_order.title: Child Order
child_order.description: Position of the project among sibling projects.

order_key.title: Order Key
order_key.description: Fractional-indexing order key among sibling projects, or `null` until assigned (backfill in progress). Always `null` for workspace projects, which are ordered via folders instead.

is_collapsed.title: Is Collapsed
is_collapsed.description: Whether the project is collapsed in the user's view.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Project icon name, or `null` for the default icon. More icons will be added over time, so clients should fall back to the default icon for names they don't recognize.

creator_uid.title: Creator Uid
creator_uid.description: String ID of the user who created the project.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Date and time when the project was created, or `null` if unknown.

is_favorite.title: Is Favorite
is_favorite.description: Whether the project is marked as a favorite.

is_frozen.title: Is Frozen
is_frozen.description: Whether the project is frozen and cannot be modified.

is_shared.title: Is Shared
is_shared.description: Whether the project is shared with other users.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Date and time when the project was last updated, or `null` if unknown.

default_order.title: Default Order
default_order.description: Default order of the project in team views.

default_order_key.title: Default Order Key
default_order_key.description: Fractional-indexing key for the workspace's shared default-ordering scope (folders and workspace projects together). `null` for personal projects, and for workspace projects not yet assigned one (backfill pending).

public_key.title: Public Key
public_key.description: Public access key for the project, or an empty string when public access is disabled.

role.title: Role
role.description: Current user's role in the project.

collaborator_role_default.title: Collaborator Role Default
collaborator_role_default.description: Default collaborator role for the workspace project.

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: String ID of the folder that contains the project, or `null`.

is_invite_only.title: Is Invite Only
is_invite_only.description: Whether joining the workspace project requires an invitation.

is_link_sharing_enabled.title: Is Link Sharing Enabled
is_link_sharing_enabled.description: Whether invitation links are enabled for the project.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: String ID of the workspace that contains the project.

is_pending_default_collaborator_invites.title: Is Pending Default Collaborator Invites
is_pending_default_collaborator_invites.description: Whether default collaborator invitations are still being created in the background.

is_project_insights_enabled.title: Is Project Insights Enabled
is_project_insights_enabled.description: Whether project insights are enabled for the project.
